verses.pali: Asappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṁ na jānāti, apariṇatabhojī ca hoti, dussīlo ca, pāpamitto ca.
verses.english: Doing what is unsuitable, not knowing moderation in what is suitable, eating food unfit for consumption, unethical behavior, and bad friends.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā anāyussā.
verses.english: These are the five things that impede longevity.

verses.pali: Sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṁ jānāti, pariṇatabhojī ca hoti, sīlavā ca, kalyāṇamitto ca.
verses.english: Doing what is suitable, knowing moderation in what is suitable, eating food fit for consumption, ethical conduct, and good friends.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā āyussā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five things that promote longevity.”
